description: This Java class implements the PaymentDetailWritePlatformService interface using Spring Data JPA. It provides methods to create, persist, and create-and-persist PaymentDetail entities within the payment detail domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: PaymentDetailWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of payment detail write service using JPA repositories, responsible for creating and persisting PaymentDetail entities.

methods.name: createPaymentDetail
methods.description: Creates a PaymentDetail entity from a JsonCommand and a set of changes, retrieving the relevant PaymentType.

methods.name: persistPaymentDetail
methods.description: Persists a PaymentDetail entity into the database within a transactional context.

methods.name: createAndPersistPaymentDetail
methods.description: Creates a PaymentDetail and persists it immediately, combining creation and persistence into one operation.
